outcome_cover.method: clang -fsanitize-coverage=trace-pc-guard edges (each branch outcome) over every linked source but the test harness, per case (tools/irc_edges.c)

boundary: from each routine entry state to NEWOPS with LOC outside the file, an exit of the interpreter bodies (lm: POODOO1, ALARM1; cm: POODOO, ALARM), or a transfer to an outside basic routine (lm: BANKCALL, BANKJUMP, BLANKET, BZF, CHANG2, DOWNFLAG, ENDOFJOB, GOTOV56, MAKECADR, PHASCHNG, PRIOCHNG, RTB READCDUK, TCF ENDEXT, UPFLAG; cm: BANKCALL, BANKJUMP, BLANKET, BZF, CHANG2, DOWNFLAG, ENDOFJOB, GOTOV56, MAKECADR, PHASCHNG, PRIOCHNG, RTB READCDUK, TCF ENDEXT, UPFLAG)
compared: Z, 2048 erasable words (A, L 16-bit) and the interrupt-enable state
